description.narrative: The development objective of Fourth Public Sector Modernization Project for Armenia is to improve the efficiency of and access to selected public services for businesses and citizens. This project has four components. The first component, Modernization of the public administration, will support improving the productivity of the CSO, public service administration, the Ministry of Justice (MoJ), and the newly established MoI, including the efficiency and accessibility of respective services. The second component, Digital service delivery, will support enhanced digital service delivery by central and local governments to citizens and businesses to increase access, expand service offerings, and provide more efficient user experience for the target beneficiaries. The third component, Data management and digital infrastructure, will support the underlying technological foundations needed for the successful implementation of Components 1 and 2, by improving and strengthening data governance/management, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and AI. The fourth component, Project management, will support project management to ensure timely and successful implementation.
The project development objective is to improve the efficiency of and access to selected public services for businesses and citizens.

comment.narrative: There is a strong progress towards achieving the target. Specifically, e-Notary services (50+) and supporting business processes have been completely redesigned and reengineered. A package with detailed technical requirements specifications was prepared and ready to proceed with the procurement. The new Minister of Justice appointed on November 7, 2024 will take the package to the Information Systems Management Board for endorsement by the end of December. The online platform will significantly reduce the time and complexity involved in performing operations such as Buy and Sale of Apartment, and Buy and Sale of a Car. EY was contracted to conduct the BPR and prepare a specifications for Citizenship and Residency life events covering Registration of the Place of Residence. The implementation of the platform will commence in 2025. The Business Registration platform is already being updated under the ongoing contract.

actual.value: MoJ has received Information System Management Board (ISMB) endorsement for the e-notary business case. The bidding documents/Terms of Reference (ToR) for the two activities (IT and legal) will be finalized and shared with the PMG by April 30, 2025. Both packages will be submitted to the Project Steering Committee (PSC) for approval by May 20, 2025. The online platform will significantly reduce the time and complexity involved in performing operations such as Buy and Sale of Apartment, and Buy and Sale of a Car. EY was contracted to conduct the BPR and prepare a specifications for Citizenship and Residency life events covering Registration of the Place of Residence. The implementation of the platform will commence in 2025. The Business Registration platform is already being updated under the ongoing contract with the Sole Entrepreneurship module already operational.

comment.narrative: Percentage increase in citizen satisfaction with selected services supported by the project, as measured by surveys and embedded feedback mechanisms, disaggregated by gender. % increase in female citizen satisfaction with selected services supported by the project, as measured by surveys and embedded feedback mechanisms. 68.1% of females and 72.4% of males who used public services reported being satisfied with their quality. The interventions aimed at improvement of the selected services under the project are still underway. No changes in the targets happened during the last 6 months. Tentatively, it is envisaged to complete three surveys: baseline, midline, endline.

actual.value: 69.3% of the survey participants expressed satisfaction with the quality of the selected public services (this is a baseline).
